The '''Cvetaen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was home to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
